admission.justification: A unit test pins that RECORD_ROW_KINDS carries the canonical Final[tuple[RecordKind, ...]] annotation matching MemoryState.record_by_origin instead of widening to str.

conditions: Knowledge-writer row indexing passes each kind from RECORD_ROW_KINDS to MemoryState.record_by_origin.
statement: RECORD_ROW_KINDS is annotated as Final[tuple[RecordKind, ...]] using models.knowledge_files.ids.RecordKind so record_by_origin receives the canonical RecordKind type.
title: RECORD_ROW_KINDS is annotated with canonical ids.RecordKind
